headline: Quiet Saturday; Grok abuse-image lawsuit adds a sliver of backlash
body: A quiet day. The only scored story: a Wyoming woman joined a federal lawsuit alleging xAI's Grok was used to create about 7,000 sexualised images from a childhood photo. Cases like this feed Tech Backlash, which gave Reversion a tiny lift. Everything else simply drifted by a hundredth or two as earlier news faded. Horizon Balance stands at -3.23.
movers_note: No ending moved by a tenth of a point; the Grok lawsuit added 0.04 to Reversion, partly offset by fading.
